finding_status.evidence: chatGeneration.ts:982-986 now gates the assignment on `response?.last || response?.generated || response?.capturedStreamText`. Verified per path: the interactive-only terminal chunk is {generated:'', generated_chunk:'', last:true} and passes via `last`; a stream that reaches done without a terminal chunk returns {} from _handleGenerationStream and no longer gets a duration; _handleGenerationAbort with no accumulated text returns {generated: ''} and is likewise skipped, restoring the pre-change behavior; an abort that did produce text still passes via `generated`. Pinned by a new failing-first test, 'leaves processingTime unset when the stream ends without a terminal chunk' (RED observed: expected +0 to be undefined; GREEN after the guard).

ChatAiMessage.test.tsx adds 'renders the processing duration for a checkbox-only response with no assistant text', rendering a message with response: undefined and an interactiveRequest whose surface is a text prompt plus two CheckBoxElements and a Submit button — the exact shape from the ticket screenshot. It asserts both that the 'Processed in: 1.50s' label is present and that the checkbox itself renders (getByLabelText). ChatAiInteractiveBlock is deliberately left unmocked so the real surface is exercised.
